name: Takeru
source:
The second son of the king of Migiwa, considered to be his next successor. He is a young man of few words, who always keeps a firm attitude. He is loved by the people as a young, noble and intelligent person. Like [url=/c88846]Tasuku[/url], he is said to be a hero candidate who will lead the country's next generation. As his royal duty, he and his father lead the soldiers on the front line.
His tsukai is a white heron.
